_doc: Baseline for WAL-machinery optimization #1 (lock-free LSN/offset reservation). Runs wal with --wal-stats 2 so WAL_STATS exposes inner_lock_wait — the per-shard write-serialization signal (every stream on a shard funnels through the inner mutex twice per append: reserve + mark_written). If inner_lock_wait is a large fraction of the append time at 50k, the shard lock is the machinery tax and #1 is the right fix. Also captures SRV_STATS (svc/applock/wrwire/durwait). Local kind, relative. 50k only to be fast.
